record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: Let A be a quasi-Banach operator ideal of exact trace type 1/r, and let AAPP_{r,∞} denote the ideal of operators S in A whose dyadic A-approximation numbers satisfy a_{2^k}(S|A) = O(2^{-k/r}). Determine whether every trace on AAPP_{r,∞} is one of the traces produced by Theorem 1.21, so that no additional traces exist on AAPP_{r,∞}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setting and definitions.

(1) Let $\mathfrak{A}$ be a quasi-Banach operator ideal on the class of all Banach spaces, equipped with its quasi-norm $\|\cdot\,|\,\mathfrak{A}\|$. For $S\in\mathfrak{A}(X,Y)$ and an integer $n\ge 0$, the $n$-th $\mathfrak{A}$-approximation number of $S$ is
$$a_n(S\,|\,\mathfrak{A}) := \inf\{\,\|S-L\,|\,\mathfrak{A}\| : L\in\mathfrak{A}(X,Y),\ \mathrm{rank}(L)<n\,\}.$$

(2) Fix $0<r<\infty$. Define the Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal
$$d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0) := \{\,(\alpha_h)_{h\ge 0} : |\alpha_h| = O(2^{-h/r})\,\}.$$
The associated dyadic-approximation operator ideal $\mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{P}\mathfrak{P}_{r,\infty}$ consists of all $S\in\mathfrak{A}$ such that the sequence $(a_{2^k}(S\,|\,\mathfrak{A}))_{k\ge 0}$ belongs to $d_{r,\infty}(\mathbb{N}_0)$, i.e. $a_{2^k}(S\,|\,\mathfrak{A}) = O(2^{-k/r})$.

(3) Assume that $\mathfrak{A}$ is of exact trace type $1/r$, meaning that there is a continuous linear trace defined on the subideal of operators with $a_{2^k}(S\,|\,\mathfrak{A}) = o(2^{-k/r})$ that depends precisely on the asymptotic order $1/r$ of these dyadic approximation numbers. Under this hypothesis, a known construction produces a family of traces $\varphi_{r,\infty}(\,\cdot\,|\,\mathfrak{A})$ on $\mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{P}\mathfrak{P}_{r,\infty}$, parameterized by suitable extension/limit procedures.

A trace on an operator ideal $\mathfrak{B}$ is, as usual, a linear functional $\tau:\mathfrak{B}(X,X)\to\mathbb{C}$ defined for every Banach space $X$ that satisfies $\tau(ST)=\tau(TS)$ whenever both compositions lie in $\mathfrak{B}$.

Problem. Decide whether every trace on $\mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{P}\mathfrak{P}_{r,\infty}$ coincides with one of the traces produced by the construction described in (3); equivalently, show that no additional traces exist on $\mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{P}\mathfrak{P}_{r,\infty}$.
artifact.status_search_result: A direct web search did not surface any resolution of the uniqueness question for traces on the dyadic-approximation ideal $\mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{A}\mathfrak{P}\mathfrak{P}_{r,\infty}$ over the class of all Banach spaces. The question is stated as an open problem in Pietsch's program on traces on operator ideals; related uniqueness phenomena (e.g. Kalton's 1987 result on Hilbert space) and Pietsch's series "Traces on operator ideals and related linear forms on sequence ideals" appear, but no proof of uniqueness in the Banach-space setting at hand was found.

status_evidence.title: Operator Ideals with a Trace — Pietsch (1981)
status_evidence.snippet: Pietsch's foundational work on traces on operator ideals, predating the present uniqueness question.
status_evidence.claim: Background on traces on operator ideals; does not resolve uniqueness on AAPP_{r,∞}.

status_evidence.title: A New Approach to Operator Ideals on Hilbert Space and Their Traces
status_evidence.snippet: Pietsch's renewed approach to operator ideals and their traces, focusing on Hilbert-space ideals.
status_evidence.claim: Provides framework for trace constructions; no claim of uniqueness on AAPP_{r,∞} over all Banach spaces.

status_evidence.title: Modern Applications of s-numbers and Operator Ideals (MFO report)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of recent developments on s-numbers, operator ideals and traces.
status_evidence.claim: Uniqueness of traces on Banach-space ideals of given approximation-number order remains a topic of investigation, with no resolution shown for AAPP_{r,∞}.
